hyperedges.label: Revert reduction levers for V3 sell-leg reverts
Mainnet Deployment Workflow (deploy, whitelist, fund, dry-run, live)

nodes.label: optimize_size
nodes.rationale: Disabled to save ~80-100ms per opportunity

nodes.label: pool_cache.prune_stale()
nodes.rationale: Exists but never called; long-running engines accumulate dead pool entries; wire on 60s price_tick heartbeat

nodes.label: pending_tx_monitoring
nodes.rationale: Monitor mempool for large swaps for same-block arb

nodes.label: P15_QUOTER_HAIRCUT_BPS (15 bps)
nodes.rationale: Centralized in strategy/mod.rs; raised 5->15 bps to filter thin-margin opportunities at detection with no added latency

nodes.label: ROUTER_MIN_OUT_SLACK_BPS
nodes.rationale: Execution-side slack in executor.rs (200 -> proposed 250 bps); lowers on-chain minOut so sell leg is easier to satisfy at inclusion; encoding-only, zero latency

nodes.label: V3 'Too little received' sell-leg revert
nodes.rationale: ~99% of on-chain failures; caused by spot/stale cache quotes vs inclusion-time pool state

nodes.label: preflight_eth_call
nodes.rationale: Rejected as primary fix: adds ~100-250ms, poor fit for FCFS/pending-monitor path

nodes.label: Export tuning constants to config.yaml
nodes.rationale: Hot-tune haircut and slack without recompiling

nodes.label: Migration Hardhat -> Foundry
nodes.rationale: 10-50x faster Solidity-native tests, native Anvil, forge script deploys, better traces, gas snapshots, no node_modules

nodes.label: Non-zero buy-leg amountOutMin
nodes.rationale: Contract currently passes amountOutMin=0 on buy leg, letting detection overstate round-trip

nodes.label: min_profit_usd floor
nodes.rationale: Phase 1.2 deferred: absolute $ floors hide most real edges at ~$1k/cycle trade size

nodes.label: Revert taxonomy (revert_class)
nodes.rationale: Phase 0: classify reverts (v3 sell floor, NotProfitable, InsufficientOutput, DeadlineExpired, RouterNotAllowed) before tuning constants

nodes.label: Dry-run mode
nodes.rationale: Default engine mode; monitor 24-48h on mainnet before toggling live via POST /engine/dry-run

nodes.label: Local -> Dry-run -> Live workflow
nodes.rationale: Staged risk: zero-risk fork testing, then gas-only dry run, then small live trade sizes scaled gradually

nodes.label: optimistic_submission
nodes.rationale: Disabled so Phase 1.5 QuoterV2 (~80-160ms) runs before submit

nodes.label: Linea Verified Token & Router Addresses (Lynex, Nile)
nodes.norm_label: linea verified token & router addresses (lynex, nile)

nodes.label: Performance Micro-Optimizations (pair-targeted scan, signing outside lock)
nodes.norm_label: performance micro-optimizations (pair-targeted scan, signing outside lock)

nodes.label: Stable Curve x3y+xy3=k Newton-Raphson Solver
nodes.rationale: Convergence check changed to dy <= 1 wei, cutting from fixed 255 iterations to 5-8.

nodes.label: Six-Step Pipeline (Listen, Detect, Prepare, Submit, Confirm, Learn)
nodes.norm_label: six-step pipeline (listen, detect, prepare, submit, confirm, learn)

nodes.label: Multi-RPC Broadcast Submission
nodes.rationale: Base orders txs FCFS; firing the signed tx to several RPCs races to reach the sequencer first.

nodes.label: Observability (exec_send/exec_confirm, SQLite, Prometheus)
nodes.rationale: Submitted != won; profit counted only when receipt status = 1; metrics tagged dry_run to separate shadow from live.

nodes.label: Hetzner CCX13 VPS (Ashburn)
nodes.rationale: Dedicated vCPUs avoid noisy neighbors; arbitrage needs consistent performance. Ashburn location minimizes latency to Alchemy.

nodes.label: Testnet Validation Phases (single, multi, stress, mainnet migration)
nodes.norm_label: testnet validation phases (single, multi, stress, mainnet migration)

nodes.label: Block Queue Racing on Base Sequencer
nodes.norm_label: block queue racing on base sequencer
nodes.rationale: Bot landed at position 500+; levers: tip escalation, optimistic submission skipping QuoterV2 on Base.

nodes.label: Event-Sourced Price State (Push Model)
nodes.rationale: Pull model needed 20-40 eth_call per scan (200-600ms); push model via WS events + DashMap gives 0 eth_call and <1ms evaluation.

nodes.label: Phantom Profits Fix: Two-Phase QuoterV2 Verification (Phase 1.5)
nodes.norm_label: phantom profits fix: two-phase quoterv2 verification (phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Local V3 spot quote is tick-capped; a 4.9% spread showed fake profit. One batched QuoterV2 multicall at full size reveals the real $0.003 profit.

nodes.label: Sync Event Schema Mismatch (uint112 vs uint256)
nodes.norm_label: sync event schema mismatch (uint112 vs uint256)
nodes.rationale: Aerodrome/Solidly Sync(uint256,uint256) has a different topic hash than V2 Sync(uint112,uint112); listener silently discarded Aerodrome events, making reserves stale.

nodes.label: Base L2 as Target Chain
nodes.rationale: Traded mainnet liquidity for 2-second blocks and sub-cent fees; high volume and EVM compatibility allow scaling to other chains.

nodes.label: Off-chain Brain / On-chain Safety Net Split
nodes.norm_label: off-chain brain / on-chain safety net split
nodes.rationale: Engine optimizes and can be wrong; contract is the final judge enforcing profit and router whitelist in code.

nodes.label: Speed vs Accuracy Tuning Knobs (Quoter, size optimizer, preflight)
nodes.norm_label: speed vs accuracy tuning knobs (quoter, size optimizer, preflight)
nodes.rationale: Latency and correctness are a dial tuned per chain: QuoterV2 on (fewer bad sends), size optimizer off (+80-100ms), preflight off (latency).

nodes.label: Alchemy RPC Provider Choice
nodes.rationale: Alchemy chosen over Infura: larger free tier, Scroll support, better WS reliability; Gnosis uses native RPC.

nodes.label: Realistic ROI Expectations
nodes.rationale: Earlier 112-267% daily ROI was based on MockRouter 12.5% spreads; real mainnet spreads are 0.05-0.5%.

nodes.label: Testnet-First Approach
nodes.rationale: Eliminates financial risk; free faucet tokens; validates deployment, router permissions and engine before mainnet.
